register.labelZh: SPLASH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: splash around 和 splash about 可以描述孩子在泳池玩水、人們走過水窪,以及其他令水花四濺的活動。；你可以用 splash something over something 描述水、咖啡、油漆或泥水等液體濺到某個表面。；splash something across 或 over something 可以描述照片、新聞、名字和標誌被展示在容易引人注意的位置。；你可以分辨為了炫耀而大手大腳花錢,以及在一項特別物品上花費一大筆錢。；splash down 可以清楚描述太空船返回地球後降落海面的情況。
register.summaryEn: splash around and splash about help you describe children playing in a pool, people walking through puddles and other activities that send water into the air. You can use splash something over something to talk about water, coffee, paint, mud and other liquids landing on a surface. splash something across or over something can describe photographs, stories, names and logos displayed where many people will notice them. You can distinguish between spending money openly to impress people and spending a large amount on one special item. splash down gives you a clear way to describe a spacecraft landing in the sea after returning to Earth.
